Drop your licensed Quran recitation / nasheed audio files (.mp3) in this
folder, then list them in src/data/audioTracks.ts (uncomment/add entries
there — each needs an id, a display title, and a src path like
"/audio/your-file.mp3").

The player will not work until at least one track is added here and
listed in that file — this is intentional: no third-party audio ships
with the site by default, since audio licensing needs to be confirmed
by Delta Travel & Tour before anything goes live with sound.
